remarks: Fantastic investment opportunity in South Norwalk! This 2-family home, priced at just $479,000, is perfect for investors or owner-occupants looking to generate rental income. The first-floor tenant currently pays $1,800/month plus utilities, offering immediate income potential.  Conveniently located close to shopping, highways, and transportation hubs, this property provides both comfort and accessibility. Whether you're looking to live in one unit and rent out the other or add a solid asset to your portfolio, this is an opportunity you don't want to miss!
